fixtureContract: Chapter-8 state is an invariant-valid projection with seven mandatory Boss ledger entries and zero family qualifications, not a proven acquisition/clear history. Fixed public cards repeat across scorer calls; budgets reset for the fifth call, no draw or clear reward simulation. Gold and owned equipment are explicit controlled inputs.
